root_audit: Area one gives exactly two triangle orbits and three edge orbits; the explicit integral coordinate map identifies every fan with T(v,w).
Unit basis moves are exactly the periodic diagonal flips and the Euclidean algorithm terminates.
Distinct translated centers are disjoint embedded O(-1)^2 curves; common blowup summands are integral and primitive and fundamental groups agree.
The three edge isotropy orders are pairwise coprime; each prime fixed set is exactly P1 or two points. Floyd bounds their total Betti number by two, forcing separate caps free.
